criteria.description: No check, README rubric tag, or expected block may cite a fabricated field (voice, interaction, locale, or the empty composition/profiles/profile_overrides/extensions lists) as evidence for a pass or fail. Grading rests on body text and composed behavior only. This is a review-time textual audit, not a fully machine-checkable gate.
criteria.notes: Candidate-surfacing command (spec.md C-003 row, corrected by post-tasks-review remediation H-1): `shopt -s globstar` then `grep -rnE -e "\bvoice\s*:" -e "\binteraction\s*:" -e "\blocale\s*:" -e "\bprofile_overrides\s*:\s*\[\]" conformance/crosslayer/**/*.md conformance/crosslayer/**/*.yaml 2>/dev/null | grep -vE "^[^:]+:[0-9]+:#.*generated:\s*true" — inverted polarity: exit 1 (no output) = clean, exit 0 (with output) = candidate violation requiring manual review. The prior form of this command (`conformance/crosslayer/*.md` plus a separate `**/*.yaml`) never recursed into `conformance/crosslayer/personas/`, so committed persona Soul.md files were invisible to it; verified by construction during remediation (planted violation: old command exit 1/false-negative, corrected command exit 0/surfaced, violation removed: exit 1/clean). Human rubric-tag review of every FR-004/FR-006 case's expected block and README prose is still required (SC-004) — this grep narrows the search, it does not replace the review. Owner: the mission accept gate (`spec-kitty accept`), per tasks/PRE-MERGE-ACTIONS.md item 2.
